notes: signature: hyphaeon.dating.run_mrca_dating, reached through `python -m hyphaeon.cli dating --method all`. --distance-mode tn93. The divergences are the model-free ones this repository already reproduces bit for bit, so the model enters ONLY through the covariance: pgls, the GLS spline (DATING Q10) and the clock selection. active_model 'pgls'; selected_clock 'Linear PGLS (parsimonious linear clock preferred, λ*=0.6984; p=0.5753)'; pagel_lambda 0.6984254721729402. PER-FIELD CLASSES FOR A REPLAY, measured against a float64 JavaScript port driven by the same ONNX dating graph: strings, integers, booleans, taxon names and the anchor ORDER exact; mu, d0, the standard errors, r2, sigma2, rmse, fieller_g, alpha and temporal_r at 1e-5 RELATIVE; t_mrca and every interval endpoint in YEARS -- 1e-3 under tn93 and 5e-3 under latent, whose Fieller g of 1.72 means its own slope is not significantly positive and whose lever arm d0/mu is 358 years.
